limits: Readback and CPU registration perturb frame intervals: do not use this as a performance benchmark.
Canvas samples are tone-mapped display-sRGB decoded to linear display values, not scene radiance.
Block translation with forward/back rejection is a limited optical-flow approximation; deformation, occlusion, specular appearance and true water motion can remain in residuals.
Use static phase-locked tests and identical-time supersampled/shutter references before attributing residuals to aliasing.
Mean/percentile/energy tracks are descriptive; no automatic pass or claim that all temporal change is noise.
